bottom_line: The council decides in February — will the buses be full enough to keep the route?

headline.dek: The town will run buses through the night on a trial, then decide if the route stays.
headline.title: Fallowfield tries a night bus

scenes.question: What is the trial?
scenes.why: Four essentials at a glance: the vote, the fare, the frequency and the hours.

voices.name: Councillor Priya Nair
voices.quote: We have heard the night shift for years, and this trial is our answer.

voices.name: Tom Okafor
voices.quote: The last run ends at 3 am, and I am the one driving it home.

voices.name: June Park
voices.stance: Would take the bus four nights a week.

scenes.question: Who is saying what?
scenes.why: Three voices with different stakes: the councillor who approved it, the driver who works it, the baker who would ride it.
